description: This file contains deprecated Drupal update authorization functions, including batch processing for project updates, handling update completion, and clearing update status. It defines several functions related to updating Drupal modules/projects, with emphasis on batch operations and session management.

methods.name: update_authorize_run_update
methods.description: Initiates batch update process for projects, setting up batch operations and starting the process.

methods.name: update_authorize_batch_copy_project
methods.description: Performs copying or updating a project during batch processing, handling success, errors, and session state.

methods.name: update_authorize_update_batch_finished
methods.description: Handles completion of the batch update, clears update status, manages maintenance mode, and sets session messages.

methods.name: _update_batch_create_message
methods.description: Adds log messages to project results, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: _update_authorize_clear_update_status
methods.description: Clears stored update status data from key-value store.
